title: Повара выходят в зал  (The Cooks March into the Dining Room)

segments.t: In the kitchen, Kostya pats Max on the back and promises he will meet plenty of other experienced women. Then, refusing to let Vika's waitress strike paralyze the restaurant, Chef Barinov marches his entire brigade of cooks straight into the dining room carrying the guests' plates.
Будут у тебя еще опытные женщины.
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
'Oh, just look at that.' The grammar packs 'about' and 'look' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Come on, do not be so upset about it.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'yes' and finishing on 'like this'. Dmitry answers right away.
Будут у тебя еще опытные женщины.
'You will have plenty of other experienced women in your life.' Notice how Russian expresses 'they will' and 'woman' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Not at all, you are true professionals.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'what' before landing on 'professionals'.
'Enjoy your meal.' Notice how Russian expresses 'pleasant' and 'appetite' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Dmitry answers right away.
'Forgive us for taking so long.' Dmitry anchors the line on 'excuse me', while 'long' completes the thought.
'It is all because of Viktoriya Sergeyevna.' In Russian, the idea of 'all' flows naturally into 'Sergeyevna' without extra filler words.
'I understand completely.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'I' before landing on 'understand'. Dmitry answers right away.
'Wait, how come the waitresses did not show up, huh?' Notice how Russian expresses 'somehow' and 'and' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'How am I supposed to know?' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'where from' and 'I' in a few short words.
'Look, the redhead is at her post.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'out' and 'red-haired' in a few short words. Dmitry answers right away.
'The bartender is working a bit slower, right?' In Russian, the idea of 'bartender' flows naturally into 'yes' without extra filler words.

'The cooks look like real champions.' Notice how Russian expresses 'cooks' and 'handsome man' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
Будут у тебя еще опытные женщины.

That wraps up this scene as kostya comforts Max after the prank, and to save the lunch service during Vika's waitress strike, Chef Barinov sends all his cooks into the dining room to serve the dishes themselves. Until next time!
